title: AutoCAD Executive
description:
We have urgently required AutoCAD Executive in our organization.

**Job description:\-**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented AutoCAD Designer to help us create detailed technical drawings, blueprints and 3D models using AutoCAD software for our client projects. The successful candidate works collaboratively with our engineering and design teams and communicates with other stakeholders, such as architects, contractors and clients. Key **Responsibilities:**

* Creating detailed technical drawings, blueprints, and 3D models using AutoCAD software
* Collaborating with engineering and design teams to develop accurate and precise drawings that meet project specifications and requirements
* Reviewing and interpreting project documents, such as architectural drawings and engineering specifications, to ensure compliance with design standards and regulations
* Staying updated with industry standards and advancements in AutoCAD software to enhance design capabilities and efficiency.

**Qualifications required:**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field
* Proficiency in AutoCAD software with a minimum of three years of experience in using AutoCAD for technical drawings and 3D modelling.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and design principles
* Ability to interpret project documents, such as architectural drawings and engineering specifications
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to create accurate and precise drawings
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders

**Interested candidates can apply and come for the interview asap.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description – E\-commerce Solution Architect**
====================================================

### **Role**

**E\-commerce Solution Architect / Technical Architect**### **Experience**

**12\+ years** of experience in software engineering, with strong experience in designing and architecting large\-scale e\-commerce applications.### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Solution Architect** to define and drive the technical architecture of a large\-scale e\-commerce platform. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, QA, and business teams to design scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Java/Spring Boot, React, microservices, APIs, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, along with a solid understanding of modern e\-commerce architecture.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the **end\-to\-end architecture** for e\-commerce applications across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable and highly available solutions using **Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and React**.
* Define frontend architecture and best practices using **React, TypeScript, state management, and reusable components**.
* Design cloud\-native solutions on **GCP**, considering scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization.
* Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Define architecture standards, design patterns, coding standards, and technology guidelines.
* Review technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability or performance issues.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers, leads, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, infrastructure, observability, monitoring, and deployment strategies.
* Ensure solutions follow security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
* Support troubleshooting of complex production issues and provide long\-term architectural solutions.

### **Technical Skills**

**Backend*** Java 11/17\+
* Spring Boot / Spring Framework
* Microservices architecture
* REST APIs
* Event\-driven architecture
* Kafka or similar messaging platforms
* Distributed systems and caching

**Frontend*** React
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* React\-based application architecture
* State management
* Responsive and reusable UI architecture
* Frontend performance optimization

**Cloud – GCP*** Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform**
* GKE / Kubernetes
* Cloud Run
* Cloud Functions
* API Gateway / Apigee
* Pub/Sub
* Cloud SQL / Spanner
* Cloud Storage
* IAM and security
* Cloud Load Balancing
* Monitoring and Logging
* VPC and networking
* Cloud\-native architecture and cost optimization

**DevOps \& Engineering*** GitHub / Git
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* Automated testing
* Observability and application monitoring

### **E\-commerce Experience**


Strong experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:* Product catalog
* Search
* Pricing and promotions
* Cart and checkout
* Order management
* Payment integrations
* Inventory
* Customer/account management
* Personalization
* Store and e\-commerce integrations
* Third\-party integrations
* High\-volume transactional systems

### **Architecture \& Leadership**

* Strong understanding of **domain\-driven design (DDD)** and microservices.
* Experience designing **high\-volume, low\-latency distributed systems**.
* Strong understanding of API design and integration patterns.
* Experience with scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Ability to make architecture decisions considering **performance, maintainability, security, and cost**.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with senior engineering and business stakeholders and clearly communicate complex technical concepts.
* Experience mentoring technical leads and senior engineers.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with **5\+ years in an Architect/Senior Architect role**.
* Experience architecting **large\-scale e\-commerce platforms**.
* Strong combination of **Java \+ React \+ GCP** experience.
* GCP certification is a plus.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience working with distributed/global engineering teams.

### **What We Are Looking For**


The ideal candidate is not just an architecture/documentation person. We are looking for someone who can **work closely with engineering teams, challenge technical decisions, review implementation, troubleshoot complex problems, and drive the architecture from design through production**.**Core Technology Stack:****React \| TypeScript \| Java \| Spring Boot \| Microservices \| REST \| Kafka/Pub/Sub \| GCP \| Kubernetes \| Docker \| GitHub \| CI/CD**
